description: **Own-move recognition at a scaled target DPI**: `proxy/src/display_guard.h` `IsOwnMove` compares physical pixels, so a DPI-unaware window thread at a scaled target still drops the guard's off-thread move (the window stays cloaked), as the comment says; recognise the logical rect too, or log and re-place once Why: the J13 should-fix 1 bug is fixed only at 100 % scale; not in the J12 report or a test Raised: napoleon J12 review, 2026-10-31 W18 built the arm and measured the map with a probe window, not yet with the game on a scaled target (jobs/W18/review.md round 2): this row is that PC proof. Two items from that review: the two new log lines in proxy/src/headless.cpp have no budget and repeat every frame if a move matches neither rect; the logs cannot name the game window's DPI context.
title: Own-move recognition at a scaled target DPI
